analyst_summary: Synthetic fixed-market facts show insufficient paid evidence and no price-frontier overlap. Use a small diagnostic trial; do not infer live demand or quality.
critic_summary: Synthetic fixture facts only: paid evidence is immature (9 of 20 required), and the price frontier has no overlap. The proposed breadth plan and service-level change are not supported by evidence; retain current parameters and avoid treating this as live-market guidance.
